## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Testing

- [ ] `swift build` succeeds
- [ ] `swift build -c release` succeeds
- [ ] `git diff --check` succeeds
- [ ] Tested with at least one display configuration relevant to the change
- [ ] Verified that at least one visible display always remains available

## Compatibility

- [ ] No new private API is introduced
- [ ] Any private API impact is documented in `docs/PRIVATE_APIS.md`
- [ ] User-visible changes are added to `CHANGELOG.md`

## Hardware tested

List Mac model/chip, macOS version, monitors, and connection path. Remove serial numbers and personal information.
